_readme: UIA -> OneBot v11 bridge for AstrBot (no injection; drives the real QQ client).
ws_url    : AstrBot's aiocqhttp reverse-WS endpoint.
sweep_every: read any configured chat that is missing from the visible session
list every N polls (the list is virtualised, so rows do scroll away).
read_mode : watch  = read the session list, switch into chats with new traffic (default)
active = only read the chat already open, never click
cycle  = switch through every configured chat each poll
emit_self : push the bot's own messages to AstrBot too (default false: no reply loops).
send_hold_seconds: after a reply goes out, do not switch away from that chat
for this many seconds, so a segmented reply is delivered in one
burst instead of QQ hopping around between its parts.
outbox_dir     : where base64 images from AstrBot are staged before pasting
(default logs\uia-outgoing, pruned after a day).
image_search_dirs: extra folders to look in when an image segment carries only
a bare file name.
restore_after_read : put back the conversation the user was viewing after a poll.
state_path : where the "already reported" bookkeeping is written, so a
bridge restart cannot replay messages that were answered before it.
window_account : which QQ account to drive when two are signed in - the
nickname shown in that window's left rail. Set it manually;
empty = pick by session list.
mute_enabled: legacy bridge keyword gate. Keep false; AstrBot's
astrbot_plugin_chat_silence owns per-chat LLM mute decisions.
mute_seconds: legacy bridge mute duration, used only when mute_enabled=true.
force_read_seconds: read every configured chat at least this often even
when its session row has not moved. Chromium stops repainting a
minimised or covered window, which freezes that row and hides
new messages from change detection; this is the safety net for
a machine nobody has touched for hours.
force_read_idle_seconds: only run that stubborn read when nobody has
touched the keyboard for this long - opening a chat raises QQ
and clicks, which must not interrupt somebody who is typing.
keep_awake : hold ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED so Windows does not sleep while the
bridge runs. Sleep stops the bot until someone types.
mute_swallow_inbound: true hides the conversation from AstrBot too, so it
does not even read while gated (default false = read, no reply).
mute_keywords: what counts as telling the bot to shut up.
mute_require_nickname_in_group: in a group only a line that names the bot
(or @s it) may arm the gate, so friends saying shut up to each
other do not silence it.
mute_trigger_names: extra names that count as naming the bot (the QQ
account nickname and the persona nickname are always accepted).
chats[]   : every conversation the bridge reads and can send to.
kind/id/name : group or private, the QQ number, and the display name in the header.
members    : qq -> display name fallback for every chat.
Conversations are reached by clicking the row in QQ's session list;
the list is scrolled with the wheel when the row is off screen.
chats[] are matched on 'name' = the text shown for that row.
